body: Airbus reported consolidated results for the nine months ended 30 September 2026, with revenues up 7% year on year to €50.6 billion and 547 commercial aircraft delivered, against 507 a year earlier. Deliveries comprised 68 A220s, 428 A320 Family aircraft, 13 A330s and 38 A350s. EBIT Adjusted totalled €4,495 million, against €4,146 million a year earlier, while net income rose to €3,587 million and reported earnings per share reached €4.54.

The third quarter was weaker: revenues fell 2% to €17,469 million and EBIT Adjusted fell 9% to €1,768 million, mainly reflecting the lower volume of commercial aircraft deliveries. Airbus chief executive Guillaume Faury said: “These nine-month results reflect the upward trajectory of our civil and military ramp-up, supported by strong demand for our products across the entire portfolio.”

Free cash flow before customer financing for the nine months was €-1,268 million, against €-914 million a year earlier, mainly driven by the change in working capital, notably inventory build-up linked to the back-end loaded delivery profile. Airbus left its 2026 guidance unchanged, targeting around 870 commercial aircraft deliveries, EBIT Adjusted of around €7.5 billion and free cash flow before customer financing of around €4.5 billion.
en.summary: Airbus reported nine-month revenues up 7% to €50.6 billion on 547 commercial aircraft deliveries, while third-quarter profit fell on lower delivery volumes; the company left its 2026 guidance unchanged.

body: 空中巴士28日公布截至9月30日止前9個月財報，營收506億歐元、年增7%，共交付547架商用飛機，去年同期為507架。交付組成包括A220系列68架、A320系列428架、A330系列13架、A350系列38架；調整後息稅前利潤44.95億歐元，去年同期為41.46億歐元，淨利35.87億歐元，每股盈餘4.54歐元。
第3季表現轉弱，營收174.69億歐元、年減2%，調整後息稅前利潤17.68億歐元、年減9%，主因商用飛機交付量減少。執行長表示，前9個月業績反映民用與軍用產能爬坡的上行趨勢，並受全產品線強勁需求支撐。
前9個月客戶融資前自由現金流為負12.68億歐元，去年同期為負9.14億歐元，主因營運資金變動，特別是與年底集中交付型態及產能爬坡相關的庫存增加。空中巴士維持2026年全年指引不變，目標交付約870架商用飛機、調整後息稅前利潤約75億歐元、客戶融資前自由現金流約45億歐元。
zh.summary: 空中巴士前9個月營收年增7%至506億歐元、交付547架商用飛機，第3季獲利因交付量減少而下滑，公司維持2026年全年指引不變。
zh.title: 空中巴士前9個月營收年增7%　第3季交付放緩、但全年指引不變
